name: bootstrap_init
description: Greenfield on-ramp (roadmap Phase 5, G3): make an empty/new directory git-ready with an empty base commit (preserving any existing files) so the scaffold agent can commit the skeleton on top and workspace_prepare/test_cycle have a base from run one. Also reports whether a first feature was requested.
